subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets + widget authoring SDK

question: Should maintainers accept this dashboard chart and widget-authoring surface now, and if so should the inherited dashboard dependency graph changes be authorized for this exact head or moved into prerequisite maintainer-owned work?
rationale: The PR combines a new enabled-by-default dashboard plugin stack, dependency graph changes, and a security-sensitive custom-widget surface with a concrete binding bug; automation cannot decide the product/security acceptance path.

options.title: Repair and restack first
options.body: Require the binding-contract fix, a clean stack/base after prerequisite dashboard PRs, dependency-guard resolution, and live chart proof before considering merge.

options.title: Explicitly accept the stack risk
options.body: A maintainer and security owner can authorize the dependency graph and review the cumulative stack as one exceptional large PR.

options.title: Pause for a narrower PR
options.body: Hold or close this branch until Wave 1 lands, then ask for a small chart/docs-only follow-up with the inherited dependency changes removed.

recommendation.title: Repair and restack first
recommendation.body: Require the binding-contract fix, a clean stack/base after prerequisite dashboard PRs, dependency-guard resolution, and live chart proof before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin Control UI product direction and security-sensitive bundled plugin acceptance, where Peter has the strongest adjacent feature-history signal.
